description: Fetch the Quora homepage or following feed as a mixed list of answers, questions, and Space posts. Requires a logged-in Quora session.

parameters.name: tab
parameters.description: Which feed to read: home (personalized recommendations) or following (content from followed people/Spaces). The following feed uses DOM fallback because its GraphQL path was not verified for populated accounts.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of feed items to return (1-100). The feed loads in bundles, so results are truncated to this limit.
